baseline_models.mechanism: Concealment is not emptiness: awe answers mercy without ocular access, repeated return organizes the inward faculty, and جَاءَ بِـ makes that formed faculty what the person brings.

activation_trace.role: Fear joined to awe supplies reverent responsiveness.
Tender mercy supplies the response's attracting pole.
Concealment from eyes locates the response before sight.
Bringing and presenting a thing makes the heart the carried result.
Heart as intellect and understanding supplies the inward faculty.
Habitual repeated return gives that faculty its temporal pattern.

changed_reading.before: A person fears God privately and arrives repentant.
changed_reading.after: Unseen, mercy-facing awe repeatedly reorients the inward faculty until that orientation itself is what the person brings.

baseline_models.mechanism: قلب can be both the pure core and an act of turning; recurrent return gives the turning a direction, while hiddenness keeps the process interior until arrival presents it.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the interior workshop of change.
Presentation externalizes the previously hidden result.
The pure core identifies what is finally presented.
Turning from face to face supplies the core's internal motion.
Repeated return toward a place or direction makes reversal into reorientation.

changed_reading.before: The heart is a possessed moral object described as penitent.
changed_reading.after: The heart is a hidden core repeatedly turned back, then disclosed at arrival as the person's distilled orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The returning heart becomes a trained receptive loop: inward insight takes in a sign, recollection restores it, understanding complies, present attention holds it, and return repeats.

activation_trace.role: Heart-insight supplies the loop's perceptive intake.
Recollection after forgetting restores orientation.
Habitual return closes the loop and repeats the focus descriptor.
Heart as understanding identifies the focus heart as a receptive faculty.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into response.
Presence with witnessing keeps reception attentive rather than passive.

structural_cues: 50:8 sequences insight, recollection, servant, and munib; 50:37 coordinates having a heart with yielding hearing while present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies those sequences and the repeated focus roots; I infer a perception-to-recollection-to-compliance-to-return loop, while a live alternative treats them as independent virtues.

changed_reading.before: A returning heart is a static pious disposition.
changed_reading.after: A returning heart is an active faculty that receives, remembers, complies, and repeatedly recovers orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent أَوَّاب حَفِيظ joins destination-return to inward retention and persistence; مُنِيب therefore names recurrence with memory, not pendular relapse.

activation_trace.role: Return to a home or destination supplies directed recurrence.
What remains fixed in the self supplies retained orientation.
Persistence and continued adherence stabilize repeated return.
Habitual return carries the stabilized rhythm into the focus heart.

structural_cues: The paired adjectives أَوَّاب حَفِيظ immediately precede قَلْبٍ مُّنِيب and create a return/guard/return progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent return terms plus guarding; I infer that guarding stabilizes return in the heart, though the adjectives may simply co-describe one person without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Munib primarily means repeated repentance after failure.
changed_reading.after: Munib describes a durable recovery rhythm: each deviation elicits return while an inwardly kept orientation persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from inattention under a cover to cover-removal and penetrating sight; against that sequence, fear in the unseen is responsive attention before disclosure becomes unavoidable.

activation_trace.role: Inattention outside vigilance supplies the failed pre-disclosure state.
Lifting a cover supplies the transition into compulsory disclosure.
A concealing cover supplies the barrier that had delayed sight.
Ocular seeing supplies the post-cover mode contrasted with unseen response.
A penetrating sharp edge makes post-disclosure sight inescapably acute.
What is concealed from eyes anchors the focus response before unveiling.
Awe-filled fear supplies willing responsiveness while concealment remains.

structural_cues: 50:22 orders heedlessness, cover-lifting, and sharp sight under 'today'; 50:33 retains the marked phrase بِٱلْغَيْبِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporal unveiling sequence; I infer a contrast between willing pre-unveiling attention and forced post-unveiling sight, while بِٱلْغَيْبِ may alternatively denote private absence rather than an epistemic phase.

changed_reading.before: The person believes in an invisible object.
changed_reading.after: The person responds while the cover still holds, before unveiled sight removes the possibility of inattentive refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated arrival constructions place the focus inside a presentation scene: other selves arrive escorted and witnessed, a companion identifies what is ready, but this person comes bringing the distilled inner core.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching supplies the parallel universal arrival scene.
Driving and conducting supplies external escort into that scene.
Presence with witnessing gives the arrival an evidentiary frame.
Something present and prepared supplies the scene's presentational readiness.
Bringing and presenting makes the heart this arrival's offered content.
The pure inner core identifies what the person presents.

structural_cues: 50:21 جَاءَتْ ... مَعَهَا, 50:23 مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيد, and 50:33 جَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ form an arrival-with/presence chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel arrival and presentation constructions; I infer that the heart functions as interior evidence, while the live alternative reads بِقَلْبٍ only as accompaniment or manner.

changed_reading.before: The person merely arrives while possessing a good heart.
changed_reading.after: The arrival is self-presentation: the purified inner core is what the person can bring into the witnessing scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context couples fear with threatened harm, whereas the focus couples خشية with the Merciful; this makes the focus response more than a punishment-avoidance reflex without erasing fear from awe.

activation_trace.role: Fear anticipating harm supplies the explicit threat-responsive comparator.
Threat and warning specify the comparator's feared object.
Fear with awe preserves gravity while widening the response beyond harm.
Tender mercy supplies the contrasting relational object of awe.

structural_cues: 50:45 couples يَخَافُ with وَعِيد; 50:33 couples خَشِىَ with ٱلرَّحْمَٰن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct root-object pairings; I infer a meaningful contrast between anticipated-harm fear and mercy-facing awe, though stylistic variation with overlapping fear remains live.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes fear driven chiefly by threatened punishment.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes awe responsive to mercy while unseen, a relation not reducible to avoidance of threatened harm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses ethical and divine diction into womb, root, tree-core, and returning-bee imagery. It remains anchored in supplied focus branches and is activated by the packet's plant/revival sequence, but should be rendered only as a material analogy, never as lexical substitution or a claim that ٱلرَّحْمَٰن literally denotes a womb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلرَّحْمَٰن/ٱلْغَيْب/قَلْب/مُنِيب as sheltered life, hidden roots, tender tree core, and recurring return.

activation_trace.role: Plant emerging from earth activates an organic development frame.
Stable, growing good supplies fruitfulness rather than mere motion.
Earth revived by rain and plants supplies renewal after hidden latency.
The womb as a protected growth enclosure supplies shelter to the analogy.
Hidden tree roots supply unseen nourishment and latency.
The tender core of palm or tree supplies the living inward center.
Bees named through return to their dwellings supply recurrent homing.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states an abstract inward moral quality.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory ecological analogy, sheltered unseen life develops a tender center whose repeated homing issues in renewal.

strongest_changes: The returning heart became a receptive feedback loop rather than a static trait.
Adjacent return and guarding made munib a durable recovery rhythm with memory.
Unseen awe became pre-unveiling responsiveness contrasted with forced sharp sight.
The arrival sequence made the heart readable as presented interior evidence.
summary.what_was_special: Context separated mercy-facing awe from threat reflex, joined return to perception and retention, and gave the heart both receptive and presentational functions; remote material branches also supported one contained organic analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: بِٱلْغَيْبِ may mark the epistemically unseen, private absence, hidden inwardness, or several at once.
The evidentiary role of the heart is inferred from sequence and construction, not forced by syntax alone.
The خشية/خوف contrast may be rhetorically meaningful without constituting a strict lexical distinction.
The organic outlier is branch-distant and should remain explicitly analogical.
